anchor.note: Generic spec for DoL releases without a dedicated version file.

integrate.note: Try the minified SugarCube boot wrapper first, then the unminified jQuery(() => ...) form. If neither matches, installation aborts rather than guessing.

notes: Used when a DoL release has no versions/<gameVersion>.json.
Only the boot hook is mandatory; the import guards degrade to warnings.
The engine boot refactor is attempted with both known SugarCube layouts; an unknown layout aborts installation.
Installer output is marked verified=false in the manifest until a dedicated spec is added.
